title: Characterizing Language Generation in the Limit: Finite Witnesses and a Separation-Width Hierarchy
abstract: arXiv:2609.10525v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language generation in the limit asks for valid unseen elements from every exhaustive positive presentation of an unknown infinite language. We characterize this task for arbitrary families over a countable universe. Generation is possible exactly when each target can be assigned a finite positive witness so that the targets activated by any finite sample have an infinite common intersection. The necessary direction follows from a universal normalization: a search through unconfirmed histories converts any successful generator into one depending only on the observed set. We then ask how large compatible witnesses must be. Positive separation width records the smallest uniform size bound, with two further levels for unbounded finite witnesses and the absence of any compatible finite-witness assignment. translated_title: 刻画极限下的语言生成：有限见证与分离宽度层级
translated_abstract: 极限下的语言生成要求从未知无限语言的每一种穷举正例呈现中，生成有效的、从未见过的元素。我们对可数全集上任意语言族的这一任务进行了刻画。生成是可行的，当且仅当每个目标都可以被分配一个有限正见证，使得由任何有限样本激活的目标拥有无限的公共交集。必要性方向源于一种通用的规范化方法：通过在未确认历史中的搜索，可以将任何成功的生成器转换为仅依赖于已观察集合的生成器。随后我们探讨兼容的见证必须有多大。正分离宽度记录了最小的一致大小上界，此外还有两个更高的层级，分别对应无界的有限见证以及不存在任何兼容的有限见证分配。每个层级都有实例存在：可数族允许单点见证，显式构造的族可以实现每一个有限宽度，而……的并集（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文完整刻画了极限下语言生成任务——生成可行当且仅当每个目标存在有限正见证且任何有限样本激活的目标具有无限公共交集——并通过正分离宽度建立了一个见证大小的层级结构。
en_tdlr: This paper fully characterizes language generation in the limit—generation is possible exactly when each target admits a finite positive witness such that targets activated by any finite sample share an infinite common intersection—and establishes a witness-size hierarchy via positive separation width.
